description: This file defines the LogWrapper class that implements logging functionality by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It supports chaining of log nodes and provides methods to log messages with optional exceptions.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's native Log utility for flexible and chainable logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Forwards the log to the next node if present.
